items.q: How is this different from other AI image tools?
items.a: zleap Canvas is a design agent: it understands and breaks down your request, checks direction with you when needed, then uses matching design skills. Results land on an infinite canvas where you can box any region and keep editing instead of starting over.

items.q: Can I use it if I'm not sure what I want?
items.a: Yes. When details are missing the agent offers a few directions to choose from and starts only after you pick one. You can also start from the inspiration gallery and tweak a few words.

items.q: Does a region edit change the rest of the image?
items.a: No. Region edits only redraw the area you boxed or painted; everything else stays the same. You can give different instructions to multiple regions.
No. Credits are refunded automatically when a task fails, times out or is cancelled.

items.q: Can I use the images commercially?
items.a: Ownership follows the agreements between your organization and the model provider. Before commercial use, double-check any text and brand elements in the image.
